{{Quote|These troops are brutal alien mercenaries of the exiled Lord Tytonus. Students of Sith politics will remember she was the rebel who declared her own kingdom on Begeren.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Shellaster (major)|Shellaster]]|<ref name="TOR:FoO" />}}
'''Tytonus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] era. Sometime before [[3643 BBY]], Tytonus [[Tytonus's revolution|seceded]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and forged a [[Tytonus's kingdom|kingdom]] of her own on the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Begeren]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she allied herself with the rebellious Sith Lord [[Grathan]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but this association proved to be her undoing when Tytonus was convinced to lead an assault on [[Kaas City]].<ref name="TOR:FoO" />
